summary:
Image identity and selected layer hashes do not bound the side effects of opening a container store. Use the exact shipped library source and actual flags to trace initialization, metadata, locks, driver probes, temp/output backing and cleanup before execution. An image-specific reference is not permission to initialize or repair an old writable graphroot. Root's primary order remains runner, bake, registration and first BAR consumer; source-only checks cannot complete that acceptance.

The earlier signed-package acquisition refusal was an armored-keyring format mismatch. A separate reviewed preparation used the same frozen package/trusted keys and staged signed files without installing packages or changing host trust. Preserve the original refusal. Acquisition does not establish executor ABI, dependencies, helper selection, runtime support or output/retirement closure. Old source versions and failed operational originals remain in explicit history.

Pinned Skopeo1.21 can use a fresh OVERLAY primary/runroot with old image backing through additionalimagestores. The primary driver prefix matters: the accepted private VFS initialization does not qualify overlay metadata or fresh probes. A writable storage.imagestore is a different branch. Set the private storage configuration before library initialization; keep HOME/XDG/cache/auth/temp/output paths private and use the full selected image ID and matching private policy identity. Private staging alone does not repair hardcoded paths or fallback behavior.

The additional RO branch opens old images/layers metadata without old container/runtime/userns initialization, stale recovery or incomplete-layer cleanup. It still opens existing old images.lock/layers.lock as O_RDONLY|O_CREAT and takes shared blocking locks. Existing file identity/type/owner bounds plus a physically read-only view prevent creation from becoming old-store mutation; counter bytes/times remain mutable. Do not claim zero-lock behavior, atomicity or no interference. Per-layer reconstruction/spooling keeps read locks until its stream closes; storage waits/io.Copy need the original external deadline, owned process retirement and hard backing bounds.

Use the actual RO constructor read set: oldG/overlay-images/images.json, oldG/overlay-layers/layers.json and oldG/overlay-layers/volatile-layers.json. The volatile path is under old graph, not old runtime. Bind presence/identity/hash or explicit absence and combine/validate the actual RO populations, refusing duplicate/incomplete rows without repair. A broader legacy inventory does not cover a missing determining path or justify blocking unrelated old holds. Bind the role-specific selected BigData manifest/config path/identity/bytes, not only an arbitrary bounded file map or matching config digest.

Physically read-only mounting of oldG in an owned private namespace must preserve its visible topology and remain through namespace retirement; private propagation and nonrecursive same-path binding avoid redirecting absolute oldG paths into a writable view. Relevant descendant mounts and selected identities still need proof. Positive payload/BigData reads require an actual directory-only ancestor chain and no-follow identity correspondence. A regular final leaf, lexical prefix and final O_NOFOLLOW do not stop an intermediate symlink outside that mount. Preserve legitimate leaf symlink metadata and separately validated intentional overlay/l links. The structural guard gap in theaea7 snapshot is documented at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404697111; it was not an observed export failure or proof of a malicious live image. Refresh changed implementation before relying on it.

Hard bounds cover all simultaneous backing, spools, staging/retained archives and deleted-open files; directory sampling alone cannot enforce them. Distinguish source/data observations from actual kernel/resource qualification. The accepted empty-journal lifecycle at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404664301 supplies mount/alias/custody/retirement evidence, not a payload/exhaustion/export result or whole-runner adoption. Keep partial evidence and the first failure when cleanup succeeds or remains Unknown; do not reuse historical operation paths or infer missing births.

Fresh primary/runroot are private tmpfs, so old ext4/overlay/metacopy flags and VFS results do not qualify native-overlay support. Init still performs support, d_type/mknod, trial-mount and metacopy probes; skip_mount_home does not remove them. Keep exact signed binary/ELF pins, real mappings/caps, helper absence, composefs restriction, hard backing and original cleanup. Read-only in one namespace does not freeze cooperating writers in other views. Bind the actual preservation disposition to operation/source/readset through child, streams and namespace retirement. Advisory read leases must disclose writer blocking and cannot exclude noncooperating host mutation. Still-required flags and pre/post hashes alone do not supply that admission.

Root selected SOURCE preparation of a smallest initializer/metadata-only role at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404733886. Pinned inspect --raw returns a manifest before config/layer consumption, allowing fresh initialization/lookup qualification without GetBlob/copy after its exact metadata/preservation gates close. The role needs actual source/inputs, role-specific writer vector and a separately selected finite operation; empty-journal inputs cannot authorize it and a never-run copy actor cannot be invented. Full export still owes payload/content, helper/fallback, concurrency, backing and retirement evidence. This record grants no invocation, helper installation, new budget, historical release, bake or consumer qualification.
title: Selected-image export still initializes and may repair the whole primary store
